_comment: Binary pothole benchmark labels. Images are NOT committed: see eval/README.md. Six seed photos are owner-confirmed positives and the tester's second speed-breaker burst is an owner-confirmed negative. Other negatives remain assistant-judged and UNVERIFIED; disputed and unlabelled images are excluded from rates. This small set is still not a release gate.

images.label: pothole
images.notes: Long strip of broken asphalt and loose aggregate across the lane. gpt-5-nano missed this one entirely, which is why the nano pre-screen was removed.

images.label: not_pothole
images.notes: Loose debris and an exposed drainage grate at the kerb. The carriageway itself is intact. The sharpest probe in the set: the live prompt rejects it 10/10, and every road-band crop variant accepted it.

images.label: not_pothole
images.notes: Intact carriageway with construction debris at the roadside.

images.label: disputed
images.notes: Silt and erosion strip along the lane, no discrete cavity. DISPUTED: the detector accepts this 4/4 under both the old and the new prompt, describing a specific defect (t049s: a broken strip down the centre of the lane; t061s: a shallow depression near the bottom of frame). The not_pothole label here is the assistant's and was never reviewed. Until a human rules, this image is excluded from the false-positive rate rather than counted against the detector.
